name: Starlight Campground & RV Park
note: Family-run transient campground in the pines off M-88 south of Mancelona; full-hookup and water/electric 50-amp sites (pull-through and back-in), tent sites, trailer rentals; themed weekends. Season May 8 - Oct 11 (2026); reservable online up to 365 days ahead. 2026 daily rates for 2 adults: W/E back-in $48, W/E pull-thru $50, FHU back-in $53, FHU pull-thru $58; +$7/extra adult. RV Life 4.5*/$$$ ~$43/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: starlightcampground.com 2026 rate sheet + camping rules: nightly FHU and W/E 50A RV sites (back-in and pull-through) for motorhomes/trailers/5th wheels, Firefly online booking, no seasonal-lease program -> real transient RV campground; published base W/E back-in $48 (2026) <= $50

lead.note: inland pine flats; no water body in the z17 frame

name: Dutch Treat Camping & Recreation
note: Family-run since 1969 (third generation) on Gordon St just south of I-196/Chicago Dr, Zeeland; full-hookup and water/electric RV sites to 50 amp, pool, fishing pond, cabins; open April-November, booked online via Campspot. Operator rates page: $48-52/night for 2 adults + 2 kids; Campspot quote for a June 2027 weeknight: W/E $49, full hookup $54. Pop-ups (rustic) limited to one week. RV Life 4*/$$$ ~$48/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: dutchtreatcamping.com rates page + Campspot booking: nightly RV sites (W/E $49, FHU $54, June 2027 weeknight quote; operator page $48-52) with 20/30/50-amp service -> real transient RV campground; published base $48-49 <= $50

lead.note: Campspot lists 'RV Full Hookup - By Pond' sites; the pond is a small private pond, not a named water body

name: Jack Pine Lodge, Resort & Campground
note: Newly built campground behind the Jack Pine Lodge bar & grill on US-2 west of Manistique; full-hookup sites with 30/50 amp, pull-throughs; nightly, weekly, monthly and seasonal stays, booked online through CampLife (Sunrise Reservations). Operator 2025 rates: nightly full hook-up from $49; seasonal $2,499 + electric. Distinct from Indian River Campground (Hiawatha NF, id 3777) 0.8 km away. RV Life 4.5*/$$ ~$40/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: jackpinelodgeup.com 2025 rates + CampLife online booking: nightly full-hookup RV sites from $49 alongside a seasonal option; satellite z17 shows an RV loop with open pads behind the lodge -> real transient RV campground; published base $49 (2025) <= $50

lead.note: loop sits north of US-2; the river is south of the highway, not adjacent
